objective: 整理已毕业Phase 2能力为无新增权威的稳定基线，并记录Roadmap一致性审计结果

semantic_brief.summary: Phase 2已由最终毕业决策确认。本任务只把现有结论整理为可检索基线，并逐项对照Roadmap；发现语义不一致时如实记录Human Gate，不修订Roadmap、不进入Phase 3。
core_points: 基线重述毕业决策和approved Specs中的既有结论
Visited、Depth、Completion边界采用已毕业精确语义
Roadmap只做指导一致性审计，不能覆盖高优先级来源
发现冲突只记录First Divergence并返回Human Gate

anchors.symbol: Phase 2 Exploration Runtime / Depth Control / Phase 3 Exploration Memory
D1 closed depth and boundary table

change_principles: Phase 2基线文档是对已毕业Decision与approved Specs的冻结投影，不新增或重解释架构、协议、owner、authority、completion或depth语义
Ownership Boundary必须声明Agent拥有Run/evidence/authorization/completion，FSM拥有transition authority，Traversal拥有concrete execution；ledger只读投影
Evidence Boundary必须声明RecordOnly依赖fresh accepted observation，ExpandContainer依赖verified subtree return或verified boundary disposition，dispatch/click/authorization均不构成Visited
Depth必须按毕业基线精确记录为Run immutable、无dynamic depth、depth 0/1/N的approved D1行为以及exhaustive cutoff fail-closed
Roadmap审计必须区分高层能力一致性与具体depth示例一致性；不得用Roadmap覆盖毕业Decision
两个文档都必须包含Expected Reality、Observed Reality、Reality Gap、Evidence Reference、First Divergence、Owner的人类可读Reality Analysis
发现Roadmap与毕业基线的实质表述冲突时，Consistency Analysis必须输出HUMAN_GATE_REQUIRED，并明确Phase 3 Preparation不得开始
acceptance: Capability Baseline文档包含Capability Summary、Ownership Boundary、Evidence Boundary、Non-goals、Future Extension Constraints与完整Reality Analysis
Capability Baseline明确Ledger无state/completion/GoalEvidence/FSM authority，Visited不等于Clicked，Depth Run immutable且cutoff fail-closed，Agent/FSM决定completion
Consistency Analysis逐项确认Ledger、Depth Control、Coverage Evidence、fail-closed exploration已完成，Memory、Safety Knowledge、Dynamic Depth、UniAgent Planner未完成
Consistency Analysis逐字核对Roadmap depth示例与毕业D1表；若编号/边界不一致，给出精确引用、First Divergence和HUMAN_GATE_REQUIRED，不自行修订任一来源
不得创建Phase 3 Ownership Analysis、Memory设计、OpenSpec、contract或实现文件
只修改scope.write两个新文档，agent workflow validator、consistency与git diff check通过
forbidden: 禁止修改Roadmap、毕业Decision、approved Specs、Phase 2实现或测试
禁止选择Memory owner或定义Fact/Knowledge/Policy存储模型
禁止创建Phase 3 OpenSpec、跨层Contract、Memory schema、state owner或Runtime hook
禁止修改Agent/FSM/Traversal/Runtime Authority或宣称Phase 3 Design Ready
禁止覆盖、清理、回退或吸收当前dirty worktree中的其他改动
escalation: Roadmap与毕业Decision的Depth语义不一致时返回HUMAN_GATE_REQUIRED并停止，不得自行解释为等价
若冻结文档需要新增authority、ownership、contract或lifecycle结论，返回ARCHITECTURE_DECISION_REQUIRED
若scope.write外需要改动，返回Leader，不得扩大范围
